title: Grandma's Banana Bread
description: The loaf we make every Sunday.
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Mash the bananas and stir in the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla.
Fold in the baking soda and flour until just combined.
Bake for 1 hour, until a toothpick comes out clean.
